instrument: SNTS Style track (clone) / Kick (G) / StandardCLIP / Clipping (threshold)
hypothesis: Phase 3 item 1 demo: prove the runner honours an explicit 'values' list instead of start/stop/steps. Two settings only, both already known-good on this clipper from snts_kick_clip_validate_v1 (0.750 and 0.782), so any surprise here is a TOOLING bug, not an acoustic finding. Raising the clip threshold from -12.00 dB to -7.39 dB releases more of the kick transient, so crest should be higher at 0.782 than at 0.750. Rig is Row 2: StandardCLIP devices[6] ON, Decapitator devices[1] OFF, set up with 'rig.py solo-device --track 6 --device 6 --keep 7' and torn down with 'rig.py restore'. The 'values' list is used verbatim: no dedupe, no rounding, order preserved -- which is what Phase 4 item 1 needs to bounce ONE setting five times for a crest noise floor.
